rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday noun for a physical place or part of a surface.

example.english: There is still a lot of empty space in this area.
example.traditional: 呢個地方仲有好多空位。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 dei6 fong1 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 hung1 wai6

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to the size of a surface measured in square units.

example.english: The area of this plot is five hundred square feet.
example.traditional: 呢塊地嘅面積係五百平方呎。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 dei6 ge3 min6 zik1 hai6 ng5 baak3 ping4 fong1 cek3

rows.note: Use this for the scope, extent, or range of a subject, object, or concept rather than a physical place.

example.english: This issue is outside our area of responsibility.
example.traditional: 呢個問題唔喺我哋嘅範圍內。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 m4 hai2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 faan6 wai4 noi6

rows.note: Use this for a defined geographic region or district.

example.english: This area has had many new buildings built in recent years.
example.traditional: 呢個地區近年開咗好多新樓。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 gan6 nin4 hoi1 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 lau4
